newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares gain in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares gain in sluggish trade.

text.p: Latvian shares gained slightly in light turnover on Tuesday and dealers saw few bright spots on the struggling market's horizon.
Overall market volume was a sluggish 46,000 lats compared to 80,000 lats on Monday and the Rietumu index inched up 0.92 percent to 150.9.
Confectionery maker Staburadze accounted for half of the session's turnover in trade of 23,900 lats at the unchanged price of 2.70 lats.
"Staburadze is not a very big company and its price earning ratio is low, but is has potential and should rise to around 3.00 lats," said one dealer.
"There are some investors who want to sell a block and that will probably push the price up," he added.
Aside from Staburadze, the market, which analysts say needs a fresh injection of new companies and liquidity, was almost inactive.
Unibanka added eight sanitimes to 3.20 lats but its volume was a puny 700 lats.
Turbulent newcomer Olainfarm, a pharmaceutical producer, held steady for a change at 2.40 lats in trade of 8,800 lats.
It has been bouncing up and down since its bourse debut last week and the market jury has yet to reach a verdict about its value.
Some dealers say it will be very profitable while others say its poor first quarter results mirror its performance.
